sections.heading: The opportunity
paragraphs: SC MEAT is looking for overseas partners to import and distribute Japanese Wagyu beef, including halal beef and specific cuts. The two markets named for this introduction are the European Union and Indonesia.

The partners being sought are meat importers, restaurant groups, premium retailers, luxury hospitality suppliers and foodservice distributors. Detailed product specifications, available cuts and supply terms are discussed after a qualified inquiry.

sections.heading: About SC MEAT
paragraphs: SC MEAT Co., Ltd. was established in June 1980 and is headquartered in Chiba City, Japan. It describes itself as a full-line meat dealer handling domestic and imported beef, pork and chicken. Its company profile reports sales of about 16.2 billion yen for the year ended May 2024.

The company says it handles raw-material purchasing, processing and delivery itself. It also runs its own retail shops under the name La Boucherie, which its site lists in Ibaraki, Chiba and Saitama prefectures.

sections.heading: Products
paragraphs: The official product pages list domestic beef brands such as Yamagata beef, Hitachi beef, Chiba beef and Shiretoko beef, as well as a halal beef line. The halal beef page states that the cattle are raised in Hokkaido under a halal process and that processing, packing, distribution and storage are kept separate from non-halal products such as pork and alcohol.

Public partner and press material also describes a halal-certified Wagyu brand developed jointly with a Japanese Wagyu trading company, using A4 and A5 grade Japanese Black cattle. Which cuts are offered for export, and under whose rights, is to be confirmed with the company.

sections.heading: Export and international expansion
paragraphs: The target markets for this introduction are the EU and Indonesia. Public sources do not yet show which export facility approvals, halal certificates or country-level import permissions apply to SC MEAT's beef for these destinations.

Prospective partners should therefore treat market entry in the EU and Indonesia as subject to confirmation. Both markets have their own animal-health, facility-listing and, for Indonesia, halal certification requirements for beef from Japan.

sections.heading: The partner SC MEAT is seeking
paragraphs: Suitable partners already buy premium beef or serve customers who do: importers with cold-chain capability, restaurant groups, specialist and premium retailers, luxury hospitality suppliers and foodservice distributors. For Indonesia, experience with halal import procedures will matter. For the EU, importers should be familiar with the country-specific requirements for beef from Japan.

sections.heading: Points to confirm before commitment
paragraphs: Four points should be confirmed with the company: the halal certification body and the facility it covers; the government export approvals that apply to the processing and slaughter facilities; the destination countries currently open to its beef; and the division of sales rights between SC MEAT and its Wagyu brand partner.
Pricing, minimum quantities, exclusivity and territory terms have not been published and are discussed after a qualified inquiry.

sections.heading: Why this introduction
paragraphs: SC MEAT is an established Japanese meat wholesaler with a verifiable corporate record, a published halal beef line and a stated interest in overseas supply. Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan) introduces qualified importers and distributors and helps them obtain the documents needed for a due-diligence review.
